name: Centaureissi U.W.

names.ja: センタウレイシー・淬翼

quote: We wait for the flowers to bloom on the scorched land.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Master. Will you be having tea or coffee for your morning beverage? Were we on the battlefield, I would recommend a more efficient method of eating, but since the circumstances allow for it... I do think you will enjoy a leisurely spot of breakfast.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: This G36 has accompanied me for many years. It must be periodically cleaned and maintained, lest rust develop. If there comes a day when I must pick a weapon most intimate to me, I would hope to have this rifle in my hands. Hm? Are you well versed in weapon maintenance as well as operational command, Master?

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Good work today, Master. Dinner has been prepared—please make sure to eat in a timely manner. If any assignments remain, I can assist you with them. Please do not hesitate to order me—Centaureissi is at your command.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Master, are you still awake? Please set aside a reasonable amount of time for rest. A glass of milk before bed may help improve sleep quality... Hm, you can't sleep? Shall I assist you with that? I happen to know a few folk tunes from the Alps region. They're very relaxing to the mind. They may help you fall asleep.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: It is nothing short of a luxury to have a peaceful life in a tumultuous world. This world is never peaceful, and we ought to savor what respite luck offers us.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Battlefield rations are certainly no delicacy. Allow me to prepare a proper meal for you—unless, of course, you wish to reminisce upon the flavors of the frontline?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Master, are you—asleep? Common affairs and combat reports are similarly exhausting to deal with, I see... Don't mind me, it would not do for you to sleep without a blanket. I pray you will rest well.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Battlefield rations are certainly no delicacy. Allow me to prepare a proper meal for you—unless, of course, you wish to reminisce upon the flavors of the frontline?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: At your command.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Please make a bit distance, I'd like to get a better look.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Ahh... Please don't...

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: You won't be disappointed.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Master... I have always believed that when the smoke of war dissipates, we would meet again. My loyalty is yours, now and forever.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Please watch as I grow.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Breaking limits.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: I shall follow in your footsteps, no matter where they lead me.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Preparation complete, ready for action.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: O battlefield, my second home.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Allow me... to finish this!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Does this victory satisfy you?

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Time to clean up.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: I can still continue...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Hm? An oath? You don't seem to be joking, Master.
Truth be told, oath or not, I would follow you with utmost loyalty. But since you see fit to establish an oath between us, our bonds will only grow stronger. Could you hold my hand? Thank you for choosing me... From today onward, whether we are surrounded by the fires of war or the walls of our home, your wish shall be my command.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: It's the New Year, Master. We ought to leave the past behind us. I hear that there will be fireworks later, please feel free to view them. You would view them with me? I am honored to have such a privilege on this day. I do hear that a major component of fireworks is gunpowder. For such a material to be used for the celebration of a holiday, the people's outlook on peace and happiness must be fine indeed.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Master, you must make sure you monitor your sugar intake. I've prepared low-sugar chocolates for the occasion. They do say that the sugar represents the sweetness of your wishes, but your health must come before all. Of course, for the sake of maintaining blood sugar levels, I've prepared a small batch with more than enough sugar in the case of an emergency. Please do try them.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Today is a day for celebrating long-awaited reunions with those close to you. With the war and strife in this world, each and every meeting is precious for those who are embroiled in it all. As for me, each and every moment I spend with my Master I hold close to my heart. I trust you can say the same?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Your Halloween mask has been prepared, Master, glow-in-the-dark paint included. If you are lost in a crowd, I will be able to quickly find you. Ah, that candy is for the children... If you are fancy some candy, Master, I've put aside an additional portion. Take your pick.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Merry Christmas, Master. I've left a present for you underneath the tree, can you guess which box? Hehe, most impressive, Master, got it on your first try. I knitted this scarf myself—is it to your liking? Make sure you keep warm during the winter days. There's always someone who'll need to depend on you.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy Birthday, Master. Do allow me to cook for you, an occasion such as this demands a plentiful meal. I've prepared a birthday cake and your favorite foods, made with the Oasis' finest ingredients. Of course, if you are feeling like some German food, I can fire up a sausage for you. Make sure to make your birthday wish before you get started, though.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
Master, cleaning day is today. Please make sure that important files are stowed away so they are not removed.
Some unnamed encrypted data storage devices were left on your desk and weren't categorized due to their contents being unknown. Please sort those out... Are there any other internal affairs that you would like me to assist with?

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: The can of chickpeas has gone bad? And the corned beef as well... thank you for the reminder, Master. With how long canned foods can be stored for, it's easy for one to lose track of time in regards to them. Ah, don't fret, it's not that the Oasis' ingredients are not adequate. I simply store a quantity of such foods by habit. They are a far cry from being distinctive in taste, but they are indeed sufficient for the purposes of nutrition. They do serve to remember older times, too. Have you tasted this fare before?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Master, all of your allocated assignments have been completed. Fast, you say? Completing tasks efficiently is a basic requirement of units of my model. Whether in a safe environment or a warzone, I can provide assistance quickly. After coming to the Oasis, some people asked whether I know how to wield "time-stopping magic"... The character in the story they speak of is indeed a maid as well, but I have no powers as mystical as "magic".
All that I do is what my occupation would demand of me and you shoulder a load far greater than I do. If you don't mind, I'd like to hear more of your past, in front of a fireplace maybe. I am sure that if we simply chat a little, we would come to understand each other more.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Mm... it's you, Master. Did you have any instructions for me?
Sorry, I dozed off in my own time. I've been a little sleepy lately—perhaps I haven't replenished my operands in time. I used to never fall asleep so easily. The battlefield changed with every moment and any sleep I could get was shallow. Occasionally, even the whisper of a small animal passing by would be enough to wake me. Ever since I've been at your side, though, sleep seems to come a little easier. As long as you're here, I can rest peacefully... I guess this is the sense of security you bring to everyone.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Some things are better left unsaid, but I can feel from how you carry yourself that you've traversed fire and brimstone, walked the boundary between life and death. Only someone who has witnessed the cruelties of war can be this well-versed in command as well as so keen in their understanding of life.
Some will say they are used to life and death, but that only lasts while death does not visit those closest to them. Even as a Doll, I have been granted a "heart" by the care of those around me... and you grant me a "future" that I can look forward to. For the future that you would create, I shall follow you till the end.

voices.label: Live2D
voices.text: This G36 has accompanied me for many years. It must be periodically cleaned and maintained, lest rust develop. If there comes a day when I must pick a weapon most intimate to me, I would hope to have this rifle in my hands.

career:
As a Domestic Caretaker Doll of the Butler-36 model, Centaureissi was selected for Project Neural Cloud due to her emotional systems having high capacity for growth as well as her combat modules that matched the capabilities of some Military Dolls. After arriving at the Oasis, Centaureissi has put into place a variety of improvements to the Professor's living arrangements and taken up the mantle of an important position in the Oasis' logistical systems. She might be outwardly stringent, but she soon earned the respect and admiration of the agents at the Oasis with her gentle and understanding disposition.

While handling daily affairs, Centaureissi ran into a dark zone in her memory data and suffered a shutdown. With the help of the Professor, she moved past her obstacles and reawakened. Her neural systems and combat modules were upgraded along with a new neural projection more suited to combat as well. She has gotten closer to the Professor, too. For the two of them, this form she now takes seems to hold some special importance.
infoStories:
As a "combat maid" equipped with combat modules from her very inception, Centaureissi displayed capabilities which put her in a league of her own both on and off the battlefield. It is this adaptability that delivered her from the cruel frontiers of the battlefield.

However, those past combat experiences left an indelible blemish upon her neural cloud, creating a deep-seated hidden malady within. It remained dormant for the most part in her daily activities, but the ticking time bomb would explode when something prompted her to call back a part of her memory. The dark zone in her memory module caused her to shut down on the spot. Thankfully, the Professor ventured into her memory pseudosphere, uncovered the truth of her neural cloud damage, and soothed her old wounds. It was this missing memory segment that informed the Professor how she came to be a "wanderer", drifting upon battlefields, from her background as a high-end maid Doll.

"Centaureissi's unique emotional system has created a rather rigorous disposition in her. In combination with her loaded combat modules and influence from her former military family, in the appropriate moment and circumstance, she can transform into an efficient killing machine in an instant."
—Antonina

After a series of sudden changes of circumstance, Centaureissi was taken in by UAS approximately a week later as a pre-signed contract was drafted. She was transferred to a Doll maintenance super-facility in a White Zone, living there long-term, as she so desired. Compared to the endless conflict and strife of the outside world, these super-facilities developed by corporations provided a far more comfortable and stable environment for Dolls.

Centaureissi's stay at the super-facility had only lasted a month. The limits of her neural logic and her inner turmoil caused her to be unable to perform her duties and her neural systems became unstable. Only a month after moving into the super-facility, Centaureissi decided to leave once more, beginning a meandering journey with few known variables.

"Akin to humans, even in an environment where an adequate life is guaranteed—without an internal goal to strive for and no direction in sight, pain eventually festers, and they seek an escape."

After leaving, Centaureissi roamed as she sought temporary work while gathering intel. She appeared frequently in areas afflicted with war and conflict.

While working as a maid, Centaureissi came into contact with and internalized a significant amount of knowledge related to military affairs. This knowledge was put to good use in times of trouble. When she was first caught up in a firefight, she scavenged a G36 rifle from a soldier on the brink of death. It became her weapon of choice during her travels for reasons such as ease of maintenance and easily acquired ammunition.

Having roamed the maimed earth and witnessed its ails, Centaureissi's personality, or rather neural structure, underwent significant change. She came to understand that if one wants to live in times filled with chaos and terror, one must adapt and learn how to face them. She grew serious and cautious, but the gentle and affable side of her appeared when the occasion was appropriate. She had tasted the torments of war and knew well the pain of a lost home and family.

After repairs were made to the dark zone in her memory module, Centaureissi inquired the tech department with regards to the repair process. The description of the Professor that Antonina gave lined up perfectly with the officer in her memory. That chunk of reminiscence and gratitude finally found its place of belonging. 

Memories are of such importance by virtue of their personal nature. In the process of repairing Centaureissi's memories, the Professor wished to help her forget the pain of the past. The two, in unspoken agreement, refer to this segment of post-repair memory as "one lovely dream". Centaureissi did not make her appreciation evident through speech, but instead gave back in her own way with meticulous day-to-day care and absolute loyalty. To those at the Oasis, the seamless understanding between the Doll and the Professor shines through in each and every operation the two handle together. When asked by others where this enviable mutual understanding comes from, Centaureissi only smiles, her mind going back to the battlefield and its ever-present haze.

"If the battlefield is where you shall go, I should think that we will meet again."

She may appear cold and stern, but she harbors a naive side deep down. She once traversed the battlefront for the past, and her future might be closely linked to the battlefield too. She now, better than ever, would know where her true allegiance lies.

After a large-scale Neural restructuring, upgrade, and her dark memory zones were repaired, Centaureissi would often describe her past experiences thus: "Many who have never seen war for themselves bestow this romantic tint upon it, daydreaming themselves as some war hero, with the laurels and fanfare that come with. But when you face it in its reality, all of those fantasies are erased in an instant. I... have no intention of spreading these sentiments to the others at the Oasis."

After her neural upgrade, Centaureissi's temperance and disposition changed in a significant manner. She wasn't the maid she once was, or the nomad of the frontlines she used to be. To be exact, she is an amalgamate of the two. Some Dolls still get the "Man, the head maid looks extra scary today..." feeling, but as people spend more time around her, they discover that the gentle part of what defined her never left.

She now values the Professor and the others by her side even more. Her desire to protect does not come from duty, but the understanding she has reached from past experiences. For Centaureissi, her greatest wish is nothing more than to keep the peace as it is and stride towards the future with those who are important to her by her side.
oathDesc: You sweep away the haze for her, piercing through the turmoil. She shall follow you, never faltering till the end.

projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
""Is this outfit familiar to you, Sir? We're finally reunited.""

projections.name: Dawnwatch
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
""The night is unthinkably long and dark, but the sun will rise. I shall be here, waiting for it.""

skinList.name: Twilight Mix
skinList.desc:
A hazy pink shrouds the beach. Amidst the waves and birdcall, she presents you with an extraordinary new recipe. Worth a try, one would imagine.
"Why not pick a drink you like in times like these? The sourness of orange juice goes particularly well with the colors of sundown. Do forgive me for recommending today's special on such a day. If there were no crabs, I could be more mannerly in my... ah!"
